_help: The arena starts EMPTY. Place things with the Lab > Map tab (they are kept in this browser), or list them here. Each object: id (unique), shape (box|cylinder|sphere|cone) OR url (a .glb/.gltf), x and z in robot-sizes (x = right, z = forward), size, color (hex), rotY (radians), solid (he walks around it, default true), known (he can see it and walk to it), role:'charger' (where he recharges). zones: hot/cold discs (x, z, r). See _example below; copy what you want into objects/zones.
